events.headline: US BLOCKADE OF IRAN PORTS IRRESPONSIBLE AND DANGEROUS, CHINA SAYS
events.detail: China, the biggest buyer of Iranian oil, says the US naval blockade undermines an "already fragile ceasefire".

events.headline: WHY AND HOW IS US BLOCKADING IRANIAN PORTS IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ?
events.detail: Donald Trump says that the US is blockading the Strait of Hormuz. What does this mean in practice?

events.headline: QUÉ IMPLICA EL BLOQUEO NAVAL DE EE.UU. A IRÁN PARA LOS FLUJOS GLOBALES DE PETRÓL
events.detail: La medida amenaza con sacar del mercado hasta dos millones de barriles diarios, golpea sobre todo a Asia y reconfigura rutas y precios del crudo

events.headline: HOW MUCH WILL US HORMUZ BLOCKADE HURT IRAN, AND DOES TEHRAN HAVE AN ESCAPE?
events.detail: Iran earned $5bn in oil exports in past month while it shut the strait for most other ships. That revenue is at risk.

events.headline: HOW MANY SHIPS HAVE PASSED THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ AND HOW MANY WERE ATTACKED?
events.detail: Ship-tracking data shows 279 ships have passed through the strait and 22 have been attacked since the war on Iran began.
